name: settings-routing-fallback-and-add-buttons
description: the Routing fallback card keeps a transparent background while its select has focus (the rule-card focus tint turned the dashed card red), and '+ Add a rule' and '+ Add engine' draw the bordered-button shape instead of muted text.

actions.note: gate: the startup tab committed, so the app is up
Atrium must be frontmost or cmd+comma opens Finder Settings instead

actions.expression: (() => { const item = document.querySelector('.settings-rail-item[data-pane="routing"]'); if (!item) { return 'no routing rail item'; } item.click(); return 'clicked'; })()

(() => { const s = document.querySelector('.routing-fallback select'); if (!s) { return 'no select'; } s.focus(); const card = s.closest('.routing-fallback'); return card.matches(':focus-within') + ' ' + getComputedStyle(card).backgroundColor; })()

actions.note: evidence: focused fallback card stays clear, Add a rule is a bordered button

actions.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.routing-add'); if (!b) { return 'no button'; } const cs = getComputedStyle(b); return cs.borderTopStyle + ' ' + (cs.backgroundColor !== 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)') + ' ' + (b.getBoundingClientRect().width < 200); })()
(() => { const item = document.querySelector('.settings-rail-item[data-pane="engines"]'); if (!item) { return 'no engines rail item'; } item.click(); return 'clicked'; })()

actions.note: evidence: Add engine is a bordered button

actions.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.engine-add'); if (!b) { return 'no button'; } const cs = getComputedStyle(b); return cs.borderTopStyle + ' ' + (cs.backgroundColor !== 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)') + ' ' + (b.getBoundingClientRect().width < 200); })()

assertions.desc: the fallback card has focus and still draws no tint
Add a rule has a border, a fill, and its own width
Add engine has a border, a fill, and its own width
